title: The bill as a monitoring signal: the spike that means an incident

videos.script: Every incident in this course so far broke something a customer could see. Some incidents break nothing, and cost money every hour. {{silent}} A debug flag left on. A loop writing logs. A test cluster nobody stopped. The only symptom is the bill. {{symptom}} So the shop watches the bill the way it watches checkout: a budget for the month, and a daily check for the jump that is not normal. {{watch}} This lesson writes the budget, finds the jump in sixty days of cost, and traces it to the meter that moved. {{end}}
